hero.headline: Learn faster with <highlight>expert tutors</highlight> built for you
hero.subtext: Ponte connects students with passionate teachers across dozens of subjects. Book a session, track your progress, and unlock rewards as you grow.

howItWorks.label: Simple process
howItWorks.title: Up and running in <highlight>3 steps</highlight>
howItWorks.subtitle: No lengthy onboarding. No confusion. Just find a tutor and start learning.

1.title: Create your profile
1.desc: Sign up in seconds, set your learning goals, and tell us which subjects you need help with.

2.title: Find your tutor
2.desc: Browse verified tutors by subject, availability, and price. See their ratings and pick the right fit.

3.title: Book & Learn
3.desc: Pick a time that works for you, pay securely, and show up ready to learn. It's that simple.

forStudents.label: For students
forStudents.title: Everything you need to <highlight>master any subject</highlight>
forStudents.body: Whether you're cramming for an exam, filling in gaps, or exploring something new — Ponte gives you the tools and the right people to get there.

smartMatching.title: Smart matching
smartMatching.desc: Tell us your style and goals — we surface the tutors most likely to click with you.

flexibleBooking.title: Flexible booking
flexibleBooking.desc: Request on-demand sessions or plan ahead. Reschedule with ease if life gets in the way.

securePayments.title: Secure payments
securePayments.desc: Card payments are held safely until your session is confirmed, with fair cancellation refunds.

trackProgress.title: Track your progress
trackProgress.desc: See every session, subject, and rating in one dashboard. Watch yourself improve over time.

earnRewards.title: Earn rewards
earnRewards.desc: Collect gems for every class and review. Spend them on boosts and exclusive profile frames.

leaveReviews.title: Leave honest reviews
leaveReviews.desc: Rate your tutor after each session and help the community find the best teachers.

subjects.label: Browse subjects
subjects.title: Tutors for <highlight>every subject</highlight>
subjects.subtitle: From school essentials to university-level courses, our tutors cover it all.

forTeachers.label: For teachers
forTeachers.title: Turn your knowledge into a <highlight>sustainable income</highlight>
forTeachers.body: Join a growing network of passionate educators. Set your price, choose your hours, and focus on what you love — teaching. We handle the rest.

setRates.title: Set your own rates
setRates.desc: Charge what your expertise is worth. No platform caps on your earnings.

ownSchedule.title: Own your schedule
ownSchedule.desc: Publish weekly availability and only receive requests that fit your calendar.

guaranteedPayment.title: Guaranteed payment
guaranteedPayment.desc: Payments are pre-authorised at booking. You get paid when you show up.

buildReputation.title: Build your reputation
buildReputation.desc: Earn Sparks and climb the Mentor Milestones ranking as you teach.

growStudentBase.title: Grow your student base
growStudentBase.desc: Get discovered through our subject search and priority matching system.

earningsDashboard.title: Earnings dashboard
earningsDashboard.desc: Track your revenue, completed classes, and student retention over time.

gamification.label: Rewards & Gamification
gamification.title: Learning that <highlight>rewards you</highlight>
gamification.subtitle: Ponte is the only tutoring platform with a built-in rewards system that makes every session feel like progress — inside and outside the classroom.

gems.title: Insight Gems
gems.desc: Earn gems for every class you complete, payment you make, or review you leave. The more you engage, the more you earn.

tiers.title: Tier Progression
tiers.desc: Climb from Newcomer to Legend as you accumulate gems. Each tier unlocks new perks and shows off your dedication.

badges.title: Achievement Badges
badges.desc: Unlock special badges for milestones — first class, perfect attendance, 10-session streaks, and more.

store.title: Gem Store
store.desc: Spend gems on Profile Frames that set you apart, Study Boosts for class discounts, or Priority Match for faster pairing.

finalCta.label: Get started
finalCta.title: Your next session is <highlight>one click away</highlight>
finalCta.subtitle: Whether you're here to learn or to teach, joining takes under a minute.

studentCard.title: I want to learn
studentCard.body: Find the right tutor for your subject, book a session, and start making progress today.

teacherCard.title: I want to teach
teacherCard.body: Set your rates, publish your availability, and grow a steady student base on your own terms.

PrivacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicyPage.disclaimer: This is a draft template, not final legal copy. Have a lawyer review and adapt it to your jurisdiction (e.g. GDPR, CCPA) before relying on it in production.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section1Body: When you create an account we collect your name, email address, password (stored as a salted hash, never in plain text), and optionally a phone number. When you book or teach classes we store related scheduling, subject, and review data. We do not collect or store payment card details ourselves — see below.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section2Body: Payments are processed by Stripe. Card details are sent directly to Stripe and never pass through or are stored on our servers. Teachers who set up payouts provide bank account and identity verification details directly to Stripe through its own onboarding flow — we only receive and store Stripe's account status (e.g. whether payouts are enabled), not the underlying documents.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section3Body: We use your information to operate the platform: matching students with teachers, processing payments and payouts, sending transactional emails (booking confirmations, verification, password resets), and improving the service.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section4Title: 4. Third parties we share data with
PrivacyPolicyPage.section4Body: We use Stripe for payment processing and payouts, Resend for transactional email delivery, and Jitsi for hosting video class sessions. Each processes only the data necessary to provide their service to us.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section5Body: We use a session cookie to keep you signed in. We do not use third-party advertising or tracking cookies.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section6Body: You can review and update most of your account information from your profile settings. To request a copy or deletion of your data, contact the platform's support contact.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section7Body: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected here with an updated date.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section8Body: Questions about this policy can be sent to the platform's support contact. See also our <termsLink>Terms of Service</termsLink>.

TermsOfServicePage.title: Terms of Service
TermsOfServicePage.disclaimer: This is a draft template, not final legal copy. Have a lawyer review and adapt it to your jurisdiction before relying on it in production.
TermsOfServicePage.section1Body: Ponte ("we", "us", "the platform") operates an online marketplace connecting students with independent tutors ("teachers") for one-on-one tutoring sessions ("classes"). By creating an account, you agree to these Terms of Service and our <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink>.
TermsOfServicePage.section2Body: You must provide accurate information when registering and are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure. Teachers are independent contractors, not employees or agents of the platform — we do not control how a teacher conducts a class, only facilitate booking, payment, and communication.
TermsOfServicePage.section3Body: When a student books a class, payment is authorized upfront and processed by our payment provider, Stripe. Funds are captured once a teacher accepts the booking. We do not store your card details — Stripe handles all payment card data directly.
TermsOfServicePage.section4Body: Teachers receive their share of each completed class's price via Stripe Connect, minus a platform commission (currently 15%) that covers payment processing, hosting, and platform operations. Payouts are sent to the bank account a teacher connects through Stripe's onboarding flow, subject to Stripe's own verification requirements.
TermsOfServicePage.section5Body: Cancellation eligibility depends on how far in advance a class is cancelled relative to its scheduled start time. Full details are provided at the time of booking and in your class management screens.
TermsOfServicePage.section6Body: You may not use the platform to harass other users, circumvent payment (e.g. arranging payment outside the platform to avoid fees), share another user's personal information without consent, or violate any applicable law.
TermsOfServicePage.section7Body: The platform is provided "as is". We are not responsible for the quality of instruction provided by teachers, who operate independently. To the maximum extent permitted by law, our liability for any claim arising from your use of the platform is limited to the amount you paid us in the twelve months preceding the claim.
TermsOfServicePage.section8Body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the platform after an update constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
TermsOfServicePage.section9Body: Questions about these terms can be sent to the platform's support contact.
